positions.as_written: Ask the patient to extend the knee against resistance and note whether that reproduces the pain.
Assess the range and look for an effusion, because both should be normal and an abnormal finding points elsewhere.
An effusion, a limited range or night pain points away from this diagnosis and should be pursued.
